verdict.rationale: AutoGen isolates code execution in per-run Docker containers by default (autogen-comm-2), which provides a sandbox for agent-executed code and reduces risk to the host system, and AutoGen Studio offers an 'interactive environment for testing and running agent teams' (autogen-docs-7) and can 'run teams in a docker container' (autogen-docs-17). However, there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated sandbox vs production-data separation, test data isolation, or staging environment concept for AI-native testing workflows. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox/production data separation, dedicated test-environment tooling, first-party guidance on avoiding production data during agent testing.
